column7: A key-material _FILE (master password, KEK, Shamir share) owned by a uid that is neither the running euid nor root is refused by LookupChecked and by CheckPermissions (strict boot check), naming the file and owner uid; the owner can rewrite the file, so mode bits alone could not stop a swap. Also TestCheckPermissions_RefusesForeignNonRootOwner and TestCheckPermissions_GroupReadableForeignNonRootOwner_Refuses (internal/secretenv/secretenv_owner_test.go).
